title: Line and Plane
subject: Mathematics
subtitle: Class 12 HSC & MHT-CET • Rapid Revision Deck

cards.q: Direction Cosines (l, m, n) vs Direction Ratios (a, b, c) of a line?
cards.a:
l = cos α, m = cos β, n = cos γ, satisfying l² + m² + n² = 1.
Any numbers (a, b, c) proportional to (l, m, n) are Direction Ratios: l = ± a / √(a² + b² + c²).
cards.hint: Angles α, β, γ are made by the line with positive x, y, z axes. Also: sin² α + sin² β + sin² γ = 2.

cards.q: Vector and Cartesian equations of a line through point A(a) parallel to vector b?
cards.a:
Vector form: r = a + λ b
Cartesian form: (x - x₁) / a_x = (y - y₁) / b_y = (z - z₁) / c_z = λ.
cards.hint: Point A = (x₁, y₁, z₁) and DRs of line are (a_x, b_y, c_z).

cards.q: Vector and Cartesian equations of a line passing through two points A(a) and B(b)?
cards.a:
Vector form: r = a + λ (b - a)
Cartesian form: (x - x₁) / (x₂ - x₁) = (y - y₁) / (y₂ - y₁) = (z - z₁) / (z₂ - z₁).
cards.hint: The direction vector of the line is simply b - a.

cards.q: Acute angle θ between two lines with DRs (a₁, b₁, c₁) and (a₂, b₂, c₂)?
cards.a: cos θ = | a₁ a₂ + b₁ b₂ + c₁ c₂ | / [ √(a₁² + b₁² + c₁²) · √(a₂² + b₂² + c₂²) ].
cards.hint: Vector form: cos θ = |b₁ · b₂| / (|b₁| |b₂|).

cards.q: Conditions for two lines to be perpendicular and parallel?
cards.a:
Perpendicular: a₁ a₂ + b₁ b₂ + c₁ c₂ = 0  (b₁ · b₂ = 0)
Parallel: a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ = c₁ / c₂  (b₁ × b₂ = 0).
cards.hint: Frequent board 2-mark question: finding an unknown ratio k using perpendicularity.

cards.q: What are Skew Lines?
cards.a: Lines in 3D space that are neither parallel nor intersecting. They must lie in different, non-parallel planes.
cards.hint: Skew lines exist ONLY in 3-dimensional space (never in 2D).

cards.q: Shortest distance between two skew lines r = a₁ + λ b₁ and r = a₂ + μ b₂?
cards.a: d = | (a₂ - a₁) · (b₁ × b₂) | / |b₁ × b₂|.
cards.hint: Numerator is the scalar triple product [(a₂ - a₁) b₁ b₂].

cards.q: Condition for two lines to intersect (be coplanar)?
cards.a:
(a₂ - a₁) · (b₁ × b₂) = 0.
In determinant form: | [x₂ - x₁, y₂ - y₁, z₂ - z₁], [a₁, b₁, c₁], [a₂, b₂, c₂] | = 0.
cards.hint: Shortest distance d = 0 is the exact test for intersection.

cards.q: Shortest distance between two parallel lines r = a₁ + λ b and r = a₂ + μ b?
cards.hint: Notice cross product × is used for parallel lines instead of dot product ·.

cards.q: How to represent any general point on a line in Cartesian form?
cards.a: Set (x - x₁)/a = (y - y₁)/b = (z - z₁)/c = λ ⇒ (x, y, z) = (x₁ + aλ, y₁ + bλ, z₁ + cλ).
cards.hint: Substitute this general point into the plane or perpendicular condition to solve for λ.

cards.q: Equation of a plane in Normal Form (Vector and Cartesian)?
cards.a:
Vector form: r · n̂ = p
Cartesian form: l x + m y + n z = p, where p is the perpendicular distance from the origin (p ≥ 0) and n̂ is the unit normal.
cards.hint: n̂ must be a UNIT vector. If r · n = q with non-unit n, divide entire equation by |n|.

cards.q: Equation of a plane passing through point A(a) and perpendicular to normal vector n?
cards.a:
Vector form: (r - a) · n = 0 ⇒ r · n = a · n
Cartesian form: a(x - x₁) + b(y - y₁) + c(z - z₁) = 0.
cards.hint: a, b, c are the direction ratios of the normal vector perpendicular to the plane.

cards.q: General equation of a plane and its normal?
cards.a: a x + b y + c z + d = 0. The normal vector to this plane is n = a i + b j + c k.
cards.hint: The coefficients of x, y, z are directly the direction ratios of the normal.

cards.q: Intercept form of a plane?
cards.a: x / a + y / b + z / c = 1, where a, b, c are intercepts on the x, y, z axes respectively.
cards.hint: The plane cuts the coordinate axes at (a, 0, 0), (0, b, 0), and (0, 0, c).

cards.q: Equation of a plane passing through three non-collinear points A(a), B(b), C(c)?
cards.a:
(r - a) · [ (b - a) × (c - a) ] = 0.
Cartesian: | [x - x₁, y - y₁, z - z₁], [x₂ - x₁, y₂ - y₁, z₂ - z₁], [x₃ - x₁, y₃ - y₁, z₃ - z₁] | = 0.
cards.hint: Points must be non-collinear so that the cross product of difference vectors is non-zero.

cards.q: Acute angle θ between two planes r · n₁ = d₁ and r · n₂ = d₂?
cards.a: cos θ = | n₁ · n₂ | / (|n₁| |n₂|) = | a₁ a₂ + b₁ b₂ + c₁ c₂ | / [ √(a₁² + b₁² + c₁²) · √(a₂² + b₂² + c₂²) ].
cards.hint: Angle between two planes is identical to the angle between their respective normal vectors.

cards.q: Conditions for two planes to be perpendicular and parallel?
cards.a:
Perpendicular: a₁ a₂ + b₁ b₂ + c₁ c₂ = 0  (n₁ · n₂ = 0)
Parallel: a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ = c₁ / c₂  (n₁ = k n₂).
cards.hint: Perpendicular planes have perpendicular normals; parallel planes have proportional normals.

cards.q: Acute angle θ between a line (DRs b) and a plane (normal n)?
cards.a: sin θ = | b · n | / (|b| |n|) = | a a_L + b b_L + c c_L | / [ √(a² + b² + c²) · √(a_L² + b_L² + c_L²) ].
cards.hint: Super trap: Uses SIN θ, not cos θ! Because the normal is at 90° to the plane.

cards.q: Condition for a line (DRs b) to be PARALLEL to a plane (normal n)?
cards.a: b · n = 0  (i.e. a a_L + b b_L + c c_L = 0).
cards.hint: Paradox trap: A line parallel to a plane is PERPENDICULAR to its normal vector!

cards.q: Condition for a line (DRs b) to be PERPENDICULAR to a plane (normal n)?
cards.a: b is parallel to n ⇒ a_L / a = b_L / b = c_L / c.
cards.hint: A line perpendicular to a plane has DRs proportional to the plane's normal DRs.

cards.q: Perpendicular distance from point P(x₁, y₁, z₁) to plane ax + by + cz + d = 0?
cards.a: p = | a x₁ + b y₁ + c z₁ + d | / √(a² + b² + c²).
cards.hint: Vector form: p = | a · n - q | / |n| for plane r · n = q.

cards.q: Distance between two parallel planes ax + by + cz + d₁ = 0 and ax + by + cz + d₂ = 0?
cards.a: d = | d₁ - d₂ | / √(a² + b² + c²).
cards.hint: Trap: Coefficients (a, b, c) of both plane equations must be made identical before applying formula!

cards.q: Equation of family of planes passing through the line of intersection of two planes π₁ = 0 and π₂ = 0?
cards.a: π₁ + λ π₂ = 0  or  (a₁x + b₁y + c₁z + d₁) + λ(a₂x + b₂y + c₂z + d₂) = 0.
cards.hint: Use the given extra condition (e.g. passing through a point, or perpendicular to another plane) to find λ.

cards.q: Condition for a line r = a + λ b to lie ENTIRELY inside a plane r · n = q?
cards.a:
1. b · n = 0 (line is parallel to plane)
2. a · n = q (point a on the line satisfies the plane).
cards.hint: Both conditions are strictly required for the line to be contained in the plane.

cards.q: Coordinates of foot of perpendicular from (x₁, y₁, z₁) onto plane ax + by + cz + d = 0?
cards.a: (x - x₁)/a = (y - y₁)/b = (z - z₁)/c = - (a x₁ + b y₁ + c z₁ + d) / (a² + b² + c²).
cards.hint: For image point: multiply RHS by -2 instead of -1!
